content: Older adults with diabetes should undergo regular evaluations to determine their risk of hypoglycemia. This process involves assessing whether they are missing doses of their medications or taking them incorrectly. Additionally, it is important to evaluate their ability to recognize the symptoms of hypoglycemia. Validated tools, such as the Diabetes Care Profile and specific risk calculators, can be employed to aid in this assessment. It is also crucial to note that intensive diabetes management strategies, particularly those aimed at achieving tight glucose control, may elevate the risk of hypoglycemia in this population.
